items.name: A compass that points somewhere
items.notes: The lever tail clicks under the peened step and held five hops; since one drop of lamp oil on the step it slides instead of scraping, and at the nightly wipe the scratch hasn't grown.

items.name: Wings
items.notes: Both side-spar joints now hold his full hanging weight; the right one, re-frapped in daylight with eight turns and four across, creaked once and held. At the cliff, lift only comes while the wind blows straight off the water.

items.name: A crayfish trap
items.notes: Lifted empty at first light and rebaited with the head half of the thumb-sized crayfish; a tail scrap waits in the tin for tonight.

items.name: Catching a fish
items.notes: The sliver gorge works on a worm with a slow steady draw. Three lines rigged and five worms kept in damp leaves in the tin for first light.

items.name: Light of my own
items.notes: The bridged lid lamp gives enough light to draw a pencil line by if he leans close. The broth's grease skin melted back in when he fed the fire beside it; the tin is cooling off the ring to set again.

items.name: A roof that isn't a tarp
items.notes: Three sills joined square on level footing stones, the first corner pegged and a peg carved for the second. The sill's slot will be one finger wide and a hand long.
